# Franco Sanchez - AI & Software Engineer

> "Transformo complejidad técnica en rentabilidad, reduciendo costos operativos hasta un 85%."

## Overview
Franco Sanchez is a Senior AI & Software Engineer and Tech Lead based in Puebla, Mexico. He specializes in designing and deploying production-ready AI systems, Full-Stack architectures, and managing agile technical teams.

## Core Competencies
- **Artificial Intelligence:** Production-ready autonomous agents, LLMs, computer vision, RAG, LangGraph, LangChain, TensorFlow, Pandas, OpenCV.
- **Full-Stack Architecture:** Highly concurrent, low-latency scalable platforms. React, React Native, Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS.
- **Tech Leadership & PM:** Agile workflows (Scrum/Kanban), OKRs, mentoring, Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux.

## Key Projects & Impact
1. **AI Business Intelligence Dashboard:** Interactive dashboard using LangGraph to query SQL databases in natural language. Reduced report generation time by 90%.
2. **Smart CFDI Billing System:** E-invoicing platform with AI/OCR data extraction. Automated 80% of accounting workflows with 92% accuracy.
3. **RAG Institutional Assistant:** 24/7 virtual assistant for a university. Autonomously resolves 65% of L1 queries.
4. **Textile Production ERP:** Comprehensive management system improving workflow visibility by 40% and eliminating paper.
5. **AI-Powered Job Matching Board:** Smart recruitment platform using NLP and CV parsing, reducing initial screening time by 75%.
